from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal, List

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Represents a single judgment document with its identified case categories."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as extracted from the text")
    case_types: List[Literal['民事案件', '赔偿案件', '刑事案件', '行政案件', '管辖案件']] = Field(description="The legal case categories this document belongs to, selected from the task's defined list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: List[JudgmentDocument]
